The '''Ulbreck Compound''' was a [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farm]] on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] it was owned by the [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] [[Wyle Ulbreck]] and his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], [[Magda Ulbreck|Magda]].<ref name="Kenobi" /> The largest moisture farm northwest of [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]],<ref name="Blog">{{SW|url=news/the-world-of-star-wars-kenobi|text=The World of ''Star Wars: Kenobi''|nolive=1}}</ref> it was staffed by a small army of farm hands and protected by regular security patrols.<ref name="Kenobi" />
